requirement.statement: Flow product adapters SHALL project stable renderer-neutral structure action references for authorable root, sequence, child-body, data-output, and completion positions, and the shared visual renderer SHALL return those references without interpreting Flow grammar.

case.given: A CtrlFlow or DAGFlow adapter projects an authorable canvas position
case.when: The shared visual editor renders and activates that position
case.then: The editor SHALL emit the projected action reference unchanged and SHALL NOT infer domain meaning from node ids, pin ids, labels, or edge geometry

case.given: An action reference belongs to another adapter, product, or canonical revision
case.when: The current adapter receives a structure command using it
case.then: The adapter SHALL reject the command before producing a persistence effect

requirement.statement: Node creation SHALL combine insertion context, node identity, node kind, and schema-driven initial configuration into one product command and one exact XnlMutation batch.

case.given: The user activates an insertion position and edits a new-node draft
case.when: The draft is incomplete, invalid, or cancelled
case.then: No placeholder node, edge, AST edit, XNL mutation, or VFS write SHALL occur
The product adapter SHALL create the node and its sequence, body, input, or waitFor relationship in one desired candidate and one exact mutation batch used for both dry-run and commit

requirement.statement: CtrlFlow and DAGFlow SHALL share the structure command protocol while preserving distinct adapter-owned sequence, containment, data dependency, and completion dependency semantics.

case.given: An InstantCtrlFlow, WorkCtrlFlow, or BPCtrlFlow canvas exposes a next or child-body action
case.when: The user inserts or removes a node
case.then: The adapter SHALL update ordered statement containment, splice simple sequences, and handle owned structural subtrees without persisting visual edges

case.given: An EagerDataFlow canvas exposes a data-output or completion action
case.when: The user inserts or removes a node
case.then: The adapter SHALL update typed inputs or waitFor facts and SHALL clean or reject affected references as one canonical candidate

requirement.statement: Flow structure authoring SHALL use the existing MVI, adapter, exact-mutation dry-run, canonical validation, VFS feedback, and canonical reprojection chain, and rejected operations SHALL preserve the prior accepted graph.

case.given: A valid structure command is dispatched through a visible canvas control
case.when: The exact mutation batch passes dry-run and VFS commit
case.then: The graph SHALL advance only from canonical reload and SHALL reproduce the inserted or removed structure after browser reload

case.given: Adapter validation, dry-run, canonical loading, revision, or VFS persistence rejects a structure command
case.then: The accepted XNL, graph topology, selection, and layout SHALL remain at the prior revision and diagnostics SHALL identify the rejection
